description: Evaluate model generalization across Celeb-real, YouTube-real, and available fake-video sources

Celeb_domain.note: 54 of 59 identities appear in both train and test; identity-disjoint evaluation not fully achievable without external data

YouTube_real.note: No identity metadata available; videos have numeric filenames only. Cross-domain evaluation possible but identity cannot be controlled.

Celeb-synthesis.recommended_split: Use existing test identities (unseen during training if pos_weight=0.5 model used)

evaluation_protocol.train: Train on Celeb domain identities (41 identities with pos_weight=0.5)
evaluation_protocol.validation: Validate on Celeb val identities (9 identities) with threshold selection
evaluation_protocol.test: Evaluate on Celeb test identities (9 identities) AND YouTube-real (70 real)
evaluation_protocol.threshold: Fixed at 0.66 (selected on validation with recall>=0.90 constraint)

proposed_experiment.independent_test_set: No independent test set currently available. Official Celeb-DF test list used once. Future: reserve FaceForensics++ or DFDC for final evaluation.

cross_domain_metrics.celebral_to_youtube: Evaluate Celeb-trained model on YouTube-real; expect moderate performance (baseline YouTube-real acc=0.557 at threshold 0.40)
cross_domain_metrics.youtube_to_celebral: Evaluate YouTube-trained model on Celeb-real; expect poor performance (Celeb-real acc=0.075 at threshold 0.40)
cross_domain_metrics.both_domains: Report per-domain metrics separately; do not claim single-number generalization

FaceForensics++.licensing_access: Requires download from official repository; check license terms for commercial use
FaceForensics++.preprocessing_compatibility: Uses same EfficientNet-B0 backbone; frame sampling at 20 fps, 224x224 RGB; normalization with ImageNet stats
FaceForensics++.note: Would provide truly independent evaluation with different source domains

DFDC.licensing_access: Requires application and agreement; larger-scale dataset
DFDC.preprocessing_compatibility: Same backbone compatible; may differ in frame rates, resolutions, fake types
DFDC.note: Larger scale but access may be restricted

limitations: No truly identity-disjoint evaluation possible with current Celeb-DF-v2 data
Celeb-real domain bias persists across identity splits
YouTube-real lacks identity metadata for controlled evaluation
Current results dataset-specific; not generalizable to arbitrary deepfake videos
Model optimized for Celeb-DF-v2; performance on other datasets unknown
recommendations: Report per-domain metrics; do not aggregate across Celeb and YouTube
For production deployment, calibrate threshold on target domain data
Collect additional datasets (FaceForensics++, DFDC) for independent evaluation
Investigate domain-invariant feature learning for future improvements
Document all metadata limitations transparently in model card
